messages:
maya: Morning — quick onboarding check. Laptop imaged and VPN connected, but I'm still blocked on SSO to get org creds and access to the private registry.

maya: Steps I tried:
- aws sso login (succeeds)
- browser Okta login -> redirect loop back to our IDP with HTTP 403
- kubectl config view shows no contexts

maya: logs/snippet:```
curl -v https://idp.redwood.internal/auth/realms/redwood
* HTTP 403
```

sam: hey @maya — saw this pattern before. I opened a ticket with infra-ops (INC-8342) and added you to the ticket. Quick checks: are you on corp wifi or using the company VPN profile?

maya: on corp wifi, and VPN shows connected. Tried incognito browser and clearing cookies, still loop.

infra-ops: I looked at INC-8342. Your Okta user was missing the "redwood-console" app assignment; I just assigned it. Also removed a stale redirect rule on the IDP side. Try a full browser logout + fresh login.

maya: did a full logout, now the Console opens but the internal dev kubeconfig is still empty and docker pulls to registry.internal.redwood.com hang at "Authenticating..."

sam: for docker try clearing the credential helper: rm ~/.docker/config.json then `docker login registry.internal.redwood.com` and share the output if it errors. Also run `kubectl --context=dev-sandbox get ns` after Jordan refreshes kubeconfig.

jordan: i just triggered a kubeconfig sync for your account; you should see a context named "dev-sandbox" in ~2-3 minutes. I also added you to the eng-team GitHub org.

maya: i can now see dev-sandbox and `kubectl get ns` returns default, kube-system. Thanks! Docker still returns 401 when trying to pull.

infra-ops: our internal registry is fronted by an OIDC proxy that uses AWS creds to mint tokens. I refreshed your service principal and updated the registry ACLs. Try: `docker logout registry.internal.redwood.com` then run:

```bash
aws ecr get-login-password --region us-west-2 | docker login --username AWS --password-stdin registry.internal.redwood.com
```

maya: that worked — pulled the runtime image. Huge relief. Remaining blocker: Okta redirect loop earlier when clicking "Console" from the portal (it opens now after the change, but I saw the loop for ~30 mins).

onboard-bot: Scheduled 1:1 with sam for today at 15:00 PT. :calendar:

sam: awesome progress. We'll use the 1:1 to double-check the Console SSO flows and confirm you have access to the onboarding repos. Anything else blocking you today?

maya: one small thing — VS Code is prompting for a company license email and not autofilling. I'll open an IT ticket; not blocking for now. Thanks everyone :heart:
